title: Finitely many bounded integral coefficient vectors supported in a bounded set (G5 c)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, Y ⊆ ℝ^N bounded and A ∈ ℝ. Then the set of all β : LatticeFaceIndex n N → ℝ such that every β_F is an integer and, for every F with β_F ≠ 0, latticeFace ρ F ⊆ Y and |β_F| ≤ A, is finite.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ (Y : Set (Eucl N)), Bornology.IsBounded Y → ∀ A : ℝ, {β : LatticeFaceIndex n N → ℝ | (∀ F, ∃ k : ℤ, β F = k) ∧ ∀ F, β F ≠ 0 → latticeFace ρ F ⊆ Y ∧ |β F| ≤ A}.Finite
